title: Getting started with PDRobust

title: PDRobust 0.3.6
text: SA() now supports continuous binary outcomes. Continuous analyses retain original additive-noise closed-form equations; binary analyses use logistic outcome prediction bounded-link HTE estimating equation. Subject-level bootstrap resampling still preserves complete panels assigns new bootstrap ID every sampled cluster. Ordinary model warnings now recorded without automatically rejecting otherwise finite, converged replicates. Bootstrap diagnostics now categorize rejected replicates retain warnings emitted accepted rejected attempts. arbitrary coefficient-magnitude rejection threshold removed. Binary estimating equations use numerically stable logistic calculations may accept finite root reached iteration limit residual precision satisfies requested tolerance.

title: PDRobust 0.3.6
text: OutPred() retains original missing-outcome filtering, treatment survival assignments, linear/logistic model choice, response prediction, row-aligned numeric return value. Separation, extreme fitted probabilities, rank-deficient nuisance fits, ordinary fitting prediction warnings longer fatal finite predictions remain available. Genuinely non-finite misaligned predictions non-estimable HTE modifier systems remain errors. Ill-conditioned full-rank closed-form estimating systems now warn accepted solving produces finite coefficients.

title: PDRobust 0.3.6
text: Examples now use package datasets BiSample ImperfectConSample standard data() loading. redundant CSV-backed pd_example_data() helper removed. Pooled HTE ORCI forest plots use stable, distinct variable colors matching point, interval, legend mappings. Tests now cover binary continuous sensitivity analysis, finite warning-tolerant nuisance prediction, successful built--data bootstrap estimation, categorized bootstrap diagnostics, plot color mappings.

title: PDRobust 0.3.5
text: Propensity-score, principal-score, outcome, odds-ratio, quantile-regression, HTE, sensitivity-analysis fitting now use shared package-level preflight checks. Missing formula variables, invalid model matrices, zero-variance predictors, rank deficiency, insufficient complete cases, nonvarying responses, separation, non-estimable coefficients, fitting warnings, convergence failures, singular estimating systems now produce contextual PDRobust errors instead leaking raw model-fitting conditions.

title: PDRobust 0.3.5
text: Added deterministic, side-effect-free simulation helper adapted package’s example-data generator. creates continuous, binary, valid, deliberately invalid test panels. Expanded data workflow tests validation contracts, supported unsupported encodings, edge cases, immutability, reproducibility, audit attributes, attrition, value idempotency. Expanded prediction, analysis, profile, sensitivity, diagnostic tests boundary inputs, model-matrix validity, estimability, separation, convergence, reproducibility, preservation user data.
